purpose: Extend the headless DXF 3D consumer probe with a positive NURBSURFACE typed-field case using complete WCS vector groups.
changes: Added a runtime-authored AC1027 NURBSURFACE with non-default modeler version and group-170 value, enabled control-hull display, and four complete distinct coordinate vectors.
Asserted modeler version, group-170 scalar, Boolean display field, and all four vectors through the typed callback under ext=false and ext=true.
The probe runs the same generated case through ASCII and Binary DXF.
scopeLimit: This is generated same-library writer/parser callback evidence only. It does not evaluate NURBS geometry, qualify independent DXF interoperability, establish DWG NURBSURFACE layout, or qualify native/consumer support.
fixturePolicy: The test creates ASCII and Binary DXF under a temporary directory at runtime and removes them; no fixture file was added.
claimEffect: No format support claim changes. The local S8.3 probe gains a NURBSURFACE typed-field case.
